goal: Prevent peer-to-peer memory and CPU exhaustion by rejecting malformed transactions during deserialization
Stops nodes from allocating memory for hundreds of thousands of dummy transactions before validation runs
agreement: Strong support after author simplified the PR and dropped the complex weight accounting commits (maflcko)
Author resolved concern that dropping malformed blocks could stall downloads until timeout (Yudis-bit)
Author adopted suggestion to scope parameter lifetime cleanly in the stream wrapper (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it mitigates peer-to-peer memory and CPU exhaustion from malicious network messages
Stops peers from forcing nodes to unpack 400,000 dummy transactions before validation can reject them

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it extends serialization utilities to support mutable state across stream operations
Provides shared infrastructure for resource tracking without breaking streaming abstractions

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it protects block and transaction validation pipelines from worst-case memory allocations
Ensures early deserialization cutoffs strictly conform to consensus rules without dropping valid blocks
